text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Ah... How utterly adorable. The Leavers 
lace adorning the case truly accentuates 
the strength and beauty of the iron ball.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I gaze at the new iron ball case 
decorating my desk, the night quietly 
deepens...
